profile.headline: SWE | USAF Veteran
profile.summary: Air Force Veteran and Software Engineer building secure, scalable solutions. I specialize in full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered applications, leveraging modern technologies to solve complex challenges in enterprise environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Basking Ridge, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: LangChain · Test Automation · Playwright · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker · Python · Computer Science · Bash · Quality Assurance Testing · AngularJS · Generative AI · TypeScript · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · Node.js · Unit Testing · Product Engineering · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Automation · Terraform (IaC) · Engineering · Software Systems Engineering

positions.title: Information Technology Help Desk
positions.locationName: Montville, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Provided guidance to field technicians on equipment installation, network cabling installation, software and hardware troubleshooting, incident ticket management, training on new technologies, and real-time support for minimizing downtime.

Leveraged Lexmark certification tools to conduct equipment installations, configurations, and repairs.

Implemented static routes on switches and routers, verified network performance, and completed circuit certification to ensure reliable connectivity.
positions.insights: Skills: Network Configuration · Python (Programming Language) · Remote Troubleshooting · Technical Support

positions.title: Warehouse Associate
positions.locationName: Pine Brook, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Successfully managed and directed a team of 5 associates, achieving a 20% increase in productivity and meeting operational goals through effective organization and workflow.
- Trained and onboarded newly hired associates in packaging and shipping processes, resulting in a 15% improvement in efficiency and a 10% increase in order fulfillment accuracy.
- Operated forklifts and order pickers to execute customer orders, ensuring timely fulfillment of requests with an average turnaround time of 24 hours.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Team Collaboration · Shipping & Receiving

positions.locationName: Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, United States · On-site

positions.title: Inventory Control/ Quality Assurance
positions.description:
- Developed and trained new hires as an ICQA Ambassador, contributing to a 25% reduction in onboarding time and ensuring consistent standards of performance were met across the team.
- Conducted thorough inventory QA checks throughout the primary fulfillment warehouse in Oklahoma City, verifying virtual and physical inventory with a 99% accuracy rate. Identified and resolved defects promptly.
- I analyzed inventory data and resolved discrepancies as an ICQA Problem Solver, utilizing mobile computer units to investigate and maintain accuracy in orders, shipments, and product quality. This resulted in a 15% increase in overall productivity and improved customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Sortation Associate
positions.description:
- Sorted an average of 2,500 incoming packages daily from fulfillment centers based on size, shape, and weight, ensuring accurate sorting and preparation of shipments for timely delivery to customers.
- Coordinated with colleagues on a daily basis, implemented process improvements that increased productivity by 10%, and optimized performance and efficiency in the workplace.
- Safely loaded and secured an average of 50 pallets of customer packages onto shipping trucks daily, guaranteeing that all items were properly packaged and transported to their destination with zero reported incidents.

positions.title: Security Forces
positions.description:
- Collaborated with local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies as a Security Forces (SF) member in concurrent, reciprocal, and exclusive jurisdictions, ensuring the safety and security of individuals and properties within the designated areas.
- Respond to and effectively manage security incidents, in-flight emergencies, and vehicular mishaps as a first responder, maintaining a rapid response time of under 5 minutes and mitigating risks to personnel and property.
- Provided area and convoy security during overseas assignments in Afghanistan, Kuwait, and the United Arab Emirates (UAE), contributing to successful battlefield operations and ensuring the safety of personnel and equipment in high-threat environments.
- Utilized advanced management software and state-of-the-art communication equipment to facilitate seamless operations between joint forces, resulting in efficient coordination and communication for mission success.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Problem Solving · Team Collaboration
